headline: Bank Indonesia Unexpectedly Raises Key Rate to Support Rupiah
summary: Bank Indonesia raised interest rates in a surprise decision aimed at defending the weakening rupiah against the US dollar and attracting foreign capital inflows.
why: Bank Indonesia uses policy interest rates to manage currency volatility and control imported inflation. Changes directly affect sovereign yields and domestic corporate borrowing costs.

impacts.name: Indonesian Rupiah
impacts.why: The surprise rate hike directly aims to bolster the domestic currency against the dollar.
